title: Book Two · Chapter 200: The Next Gate
story:
Near the end of summer, Leo comes to the green door for one last walk before the journey. Ronan is waiting with his birthday book under his arm.

“You are taking that?” Leo asks.

“Only to show you the first page I marked.”

Their two addresses are inside the cover. Ronan gives Leo his own note. Leo checks the street number and puts it carefully in his new exercise book.

They walk past Mr Qiu's table. The sign for Mr Qiu's own books is still there. The little weight holds it in place. Mr Qiu sees them and lifts a hand.

At the river, the boys stop by the fence. They talk about the journey time and the small bedroom. Then both boys grow quiet. Ronan does not know what to say next.

A leaf moves along the water below the fence. Ronan follows it until it passes behind a dark patch beneath the trees.

He looks back at Leo.

“Will you have space for your books?”

“A little shelf by the bed.”

“All of them?”

“Not all. Some will stay here.”

Ronan holds the birthday book closer to his side.

“Your aunt may need a bigger house.”

“First I need a smaller bag.”

They smile. Leo rests his arms on the top of the fence. Ronan stands beside him.

He wants to ask whether the new school will have a better place for games. If it does, he wants Leo to enjoy it. He also wants this path to stay special.

He cannot put both thoughts into a question.

Leo turns from the water. Ronan looks at his friend's face instead of the place where the leaf disappeared.

“You can write,” Leo says.

“So can you.”

“I will.”

Ronan nods. He does not ask how often. Leo has never lived so far away before.

On the walk back, they buy one bun and split it. This time, Leo makes the pieces almost equal. Ronan takes the slightly larger one and lets Leo complain.

At the corner, they stand together for a moment. Then Ronan puts one arm around his friend's shoulders. Leo puts his arms around Ronan too. The hug is hard and quick.

“Go,” Ronan says. “Your family is waiting.”

Leo goes. He turns once, lifts his hand, and disappears around the corner toward his own home. The journey will begin in the morning.

Ronan walks to the green door alone. Dad is home from Mr Sun's place. Mum has finished a coat and laid it safely inside its cover. The blue bike stands clear of the gate.

Ronan opens his drawer. The six old practice pages and the four-week work sheet are inside. He still has three good results from the six practices. The extra mark is gone. Later, he did the new tests alone. Those answers earned a trial place. He finished the four weeks.

He leaves the papers in the drawer. He has no need to carry them tonight.

“The new building?” Dad asks.

Ronan nods. At the holiday meeting, he asked the school office his question. They explained the sentence on the family sheet. He knows the place and the first-day time now.

They walk to the new school entrance before dark. Ronan pushes the blue bike through the busy lanes. Mum points out a food shop she wants to try another day. Dad stops to look at a wooden door.

At the school gate, Ronan finds his name on the new list. There are many names he does not know yet. He reads his own once. Then he looks into the quiet yard.

“Tomorrow,” Mum says.

“Tomorrow.”

They turn toward home. Ronan keeps one hand on the handlebar. At the wide corner, he rings the old bell once. He waits for his parents. Then he walks on beside them.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

journey＝旅程；split＝分开；slightly＝稍微；entrance＝入口。

## 理解问题

1. 本卷的错误成绩、真实损失与新机会，分别怎样收束？
2. Leo、Jun和家人的生活有哪些边界和未完的变化会带进下一卷？

## 读句子

**He reads his own once.**

拆开看：He / reads / his own once.

他／读了一遍／自己的名字。
